body: Finnair has opened a daily service between Helsinki Airport and Melbourne Airport via Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport, bringing Australia into the carrier's own scheduled network for the first time. First flight AY145 departed Helsinki at 01:15 local time on October 25 on an Airbus A350-900 registered OH-LWO, scheduled to arrive in Melbourne at 07:20 local time on October 26 after a journey of 22 hours and five minutes.

The year-round service stops in Bangkok for just under two hours, with passengers remaining on the same aircraft for the whole journey but required to leave the cabin during the stop; each sector can also be booked separately, including Bangkok–Melbourne. Finnair said Melbourne was chosen as a long-haul destination with demand through the year, citing its mix of leisure and business travel, large European community and international students and expatriate workers, and said business class uses its AirLounge seats. In cargo, Finnair Cargo will not initially accept pharmaceuticals, perishables or other temperature-controlled goods for the full Helsinki–Melbourne journey, although individual sectors can be accepted under applicable rules. In Bangkok, Finnair has stocked 18,000 litres of its signature blueberry juice, enough for about three months, and economy passengers flying from Melbourne to Bangkok receive a Tim Tam biscuit with their meal.
en.summary: Finnair has launched a daily, year-round Airbus A350 service between Helsinki and Melbourne via Bangkok, with first flight AY145 departing on October 25 and taking 22 hours and five minutes including a stop of under two hours in Bangkok.
en.title: Finnair launches daily A350 service from Helsinki to Melbourne via Bangkok

body: 芬蘭航空已開通赫爾辛基機場與墨爾本機場之間經曼谷素萬那普機場的每日航班，成為該公司自營定期航網首度納入澳洲。首航航班AY145於10月25日當地時間凌晨1時15分自赫爾辛基出發，執飛機型為空中巴士A350-900、註冊編號OH-LWO，預定10月26日當地時間上午7時20分抵達墨爾本，全程約22小時5分鐘。

該全年服務在曼谷中停不到2小時，旅客全程搭乘同一架飛機，但中停期間必須離開機艙並接受安檢；各航段亦可單獨訂位，包括曼谷—墨爾本航段。芬蘭航空表示，選擇墨爾本是因為尋找可全年維持需求的長程目的地，墨爾本在休閒與商務旅遊組合、大型歐洲社群以及國際學生與外籍工作者方面突出；機上商務艙採用AirLounge座椅，貨運方面初期不受理全程赫爾辛基—墨爾本的藥品、生鮮或其他溫控貨物。芬蘭航空在曼谷的新餐飲基地已備妥約可供應3個月的招牌藍莓汁，自墨爾本飛往曼谷的經濟艙旅客餐食附上一塊Tim Tam巧克力餅乾。
zh.summary: 芬蘭航空空中巴士A350-900首航赫爾辛基—墨爾本航線，經曼谷中停不到2小時，全程約22小時5分鐘，成為該公司自營定期航網首度納入澳洲的每日全年服務。
zh.title: 芬航A350每日飛赫爾辛基—墨爾本，經曼谷中停不到2小時
